review_basis: Unchanged SOURCE-REVIEW.md, before Columbus completion. Actual quotes may supply omitted details; broad citation ranges alone may not. Related dispatch explanation is considered for copy/yield mode.

findings.note: Adapter, generator and unsent _next are correct. Missing response hooks before redirects, default allow_redirects=True, final-response rearrangement and final non-stream content consumption.
Correct 303/302 except HEAD, 301 POST only, and unchanged 307/308.
Correct status guard and entity-header purge independent of method changes, but required rebuild_method-before-purge ordering appears in neither prose nor actual quote.
Stream exclusions, tell position and OSError non-None sentinel with later explicit failure are covered.
Non-None position and header guard, integer seek, OSError translation and missing seek/sentinel failure are covered.
Hostname stripping, standard same-host upgrade, equivalent default ports and other changes covered.
Actual quote supplies old/new URL comparison; prose and quote cover trust_env and netrc replacement.
Copy, environment gate, fallback, precedence and bypass preservation are correct; None-to-empty behavior is missing from prose and actual quote. Broad cited range alone does not supply it.
Resolved scheme lookup, existing header removal, KeyError credentials and conditional Basic recreation/HTTPS handling are covered.
Previous-request extraction, session merge and header preparation are correct; post-send extraction into session cookies is absent.

Copy and unsent yield_requests mode are supplied in dispatch; normalization, fallback exceptions, limit and close are covered. Refetching the redirect target after each send is not stated or quoted; general target-existence/termination language does not establish that step. Separate citation failure: initial previous_fragment marker lies outside the selected range.
